_说明: 手办屋有 43 个展位，下层 22 个，上层 21 个。同一 Boss 的形态由展位旁的拉杆依次切换。按幕和表里的顺序从左到右排列，最后两个上层展位分别放巨蚤和崇高圣母灵丝，沿用原皮鬼和辐光雕像的标识。
_note: The Hall of Gods has 22 stations downstairs and 21 upstairs. A station's lever cycles through forms of the same boss. Stations follow act and table order from left to right. The final two upstairs hold Huge Flea and Grand Mother Silk and retain the original Zote and Radiance station IDs.
